newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA OTC MARKET SLIPS, SHARE PRICES MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA OTC MARKET SLIPS, SHARE PRICES MIXED.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market saw idlle trading on Monday, when share prices closed mixed and turnover inched higher, brokers said.
"Buyers were only few and most players were seeking better prices," said one trader.
Brokers expected trading to remain subdued on Tuesday.
The VAB-RA all-share index edged down by 1.4 percent to 6,483.5 points. The BIG-OTC lost 1.02 percent to 4,602.9 points and the CAS-RQ shed by 1.21 percent to 995 points.
Gainers outnumbered losers in late trading by 178 to 146. Prices for 310 stocks stayed flat. Turnover rose to 19.77 billion lei from 16.27 billion previously.
Oil refineries and cement makers were in the focus on Monday.

Cement maker Romcim closed flat at 120,000 lei, but traders said several transactions had been struck at 125,000. Romcim was expected to rise further to 130,000 lei after the State Ownership Fund, its main shareholder, announced bidders for a 51 percent stake in the company.
Petrobrazi refinery closed 1,000 lei firmer at 46,000 lei, while Petromidia, another refinery, ended 2,200 lei up at 42,700.

Steel mill Sidex finished at 23,500 lei, unchanged from Friday's closing level. Steel wire maker Ductil, one of the companies which have attracted investors over the past weeks, inched down 200 lei to 3,300 under selling pressure.
